mapper.select: select a.user_id userName,c.real_name realName, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( d.asset_type, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (d.asset_type)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') finprodType2,c.DEPT_CODE deptCode from sys_user_role a inner join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.role_id inner join sys_user c on a.user_id=c.user_name left join AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT d on a.user_id=d.user_id where b.role_pos = '06' group by a.user_id,c.real_name,c.DEPT_CODE

SELECT ee.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, su.REAL_NAME invManagerName, sd.DEPT_NAME belongsDept, B.realName trader, ee.COUNTER_ID counterId, mcp.COUNTER_NAME counterName, ee.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, NVL(mcct.TRADER_NAME, ee.COUNTER_TRADER) counterTraderName, ee.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo FROM ETR_ENTRUST ee LEFT JOIN ( SELECT listagg ( TRADER, ',' ) within GROUP ( ORDER BY TRADER ) TRADER, listagg ( REAL_NAME, ',' ) within GROUP ( ORDER BY TRADER ) realName, ENTRUST_ID AS ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE LEFT JOIN SYS_USER ON ETR_DISTRIBUTE.TRADER = SYS_USER.USER_NAME GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) B ON B.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su ON su.USER_NAME = ee.INV_MANAGER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON mcp.COUNTER_ID = ee.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct ON mcct.TRADER_ID = ee.COUNTER_TRADER LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPT_CODE = su.DEPT_CODE WHERE ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
mapper.sql: #{busiTypePosition} busiTypePosition, tpda.entrust_id entrustId, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID pledgeFinprodId, NVL( fp2.FINPROD_ABBR, fp2.FINPROD_NAME ) chlIdName, tpd.trade_market tradeMarket, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE fCprice, tpd.YIELD * 100 fYield, tpd.FPRICE_AMT vTradeAmt, FTP.M_TRADE_AMT mSettleAmt, fpt.TYPE_6 paBussType, fpt.TYPE_9 assetType1, fpt.TYPE_10 assetType10, fpt.TYPE_11 assetType11, tpd.share_amt shareAmt, to_char( tpda.PUR_CFM_DATE , 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) purCfmDate, tpd.totle_trade_id totleTradeId, tpd.trade_id tradeId, tpda.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, tpdt.ps ps, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, to_char(tpd.trade_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, DECODE(tpd.settle_speed,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed, to_char(tpd.settle_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, tpd.unit_cprice unitPrice, tpd.yield*100 matureYield, tpd.exer_yield*100 exerYield, tpd.share_amt/100 shareNum, tpd.unit_int unitInt, tpd.unit_fprice allPrice, tpd.cprice_amt cpriceAmt, tpd.int_amt intAmt, tpd.fprice_amt fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, tpd.ccy ccy, tpd.counter_id counterId, mcp.counter_name counterName, tpd.remark remark, ftp.TERM_TYPE termType, ftp.TERM repoTerm, TO_CHAR(FTP.VPAY_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') vpayDate,/*首次结算日*/ TO_CHAR(FTP.MPAY_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') mpayDate,/*到期结算日*/ ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS actCapDays, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 rebackPrice, TPD.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, FTP.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, /*回购利息*/ FTP.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt,/* 到期金额*/ FTP.M_UNIT_CPRICE mCprice, FTP.M_YIELD * 100 mYield, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100 secTotalPrin
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME userName, su.REAL_NAME realName, to_char(NVL(a.totalWork,0)+nvl(b.unfinishedWork,0),'fm999990.009') as totalWork, to_char(NVL(b.unfinishedWork,0),'fm999990.009') as unfinishedWork FROM SYS_USER su INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON su.USER_NAME = sur.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE sr ON sur.ROLE_ID = sr.ROLE_ID AND sr.ROLE_POS in (06) LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ed ON ed.TRADER=su.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, COUNT(edi.TRADER) AS totalWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('04') and een.ENTRUST_DATE=to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY edi.TRADER ) a ON su.USER_NAME = a.TRADER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, COUNT(edi.TRADER) AS unfinishedWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03') GROUP BY edi.TRADER) b ON b.TRADER=su.USER_NAME

mapper.select: SELECT T1.REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER T1 where T1.USER_NAME = #{userName}

select listagg(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') WITHIN GROUP ( order by er.VDATE) distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, to_char(er.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(er.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and er.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE

select OUTPUT_VALUE_1 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG btm left join ETR_ENTRUST ON (ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_TYPE2 = btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.Ps = btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_PLAT = btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 IS NULL) where ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}

SELECT #{busiTypePosition} busiTypePosition, to_char(ete.entrust_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') entrustDate, ete.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, ete.inv_aim busiModel, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, nvl(fp.finprod_abbr,ete.finprod_id) finprodAbbr, ete.trade_market tradeMarket, ete.ps ps, DECODE(eted.SETTLE_SPREED,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed, ete.price_model priceModel, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, ete.ccy ccy, ete.entrust_num/100 shareNum, eted.our_ent_num/100 entrustOwnNum, eted.lendin_ent_num integrateSecAmount, ete.price unitPrice, eted.full_price allPrice, eted.mature_yield*100 matureYield, eted.exer_yield*100 exerYield, eted.full_price*ete.entrust_num fpriceAmt, ete.remark remark, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME mainConsignee, to_char(eted.payment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') paymentDate, to_char(eted.listing_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') listingDate, ete.entrust_num entrustNum,
decode( eted.ASSET_TYPE, 'F01', decode(ete.PS,'T03',ete.ENTRUST_AMT,NVL(ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 )), 'F10', NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 ), NVL( ete.ENTRUST_AMT, ete.ENTRUST_NUM ) ) entrustAmt, eted.deal_mode dealMode, eted.term_type termType, to_char(eted.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || ' - ' || to_char(eted.MDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dueDate, eted.TERM_DAYS repoTerm, eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE || ' - ' || eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE2 firstprice, pss.pledge_stock_name pledgeStockName, eted.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ete.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, eted.TARGET_TYPE targetType, ete.COUNTER_ID counterId, eted.COUNTER_SEAT counterSeat, eted.COUNTER_CON_NO counterConNo, eted.TRADER trader, ete.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, FPC.CON_SHARE_ID conId, T5.FINPROD_NAME conName, eted.EXP_CON_VALUE expConValue, eted.EXP_CON_NUM expConNum, eted.PREB preb, eted.PREC prec, fpt.TYPE_11 secType, eted.DEAL_CUR_ACCT dealCurAcct, eted.REQUEST_ID requestId, eted.CAP_DAYS capDays, to_char(eted.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vpayDate, to_char(eted.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate, eted.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, eted.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt, nvl(ee.Pledge_Ratio * 100,fscr.SCALE) pledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.Pledge_Face_Value pledStrdPrinAmt, eted.TRADE_ID tradeId, oee.Pledge_Ratio * 100 oldPledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER oldPledgeNumber, oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * oee.Pledge_Face_Value oldPledStrdPrinAmt, T6.finprod_market_id oldFinprodMarketId, eted.DEAL_MODE dealMode, /** 申报类型 **/ nvl(ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.PLEDGE_RATIO , ete.ENTRUST_NUM) pledgeStandardNumber, /** 标准券额度 **/ fp.Is_Right isRight,sci.ACCT_NAME trdAcctId FROM ETR_ENTRUST ete INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eted ON ete.entrust_id = eted.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE FPC ON ete.FINPROD_ID = FPC.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON FPC.CON_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ete.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ete.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ete.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_STOCK pss ON pss.pledge_stock_id = eted.pledge_stock_id AND ete.portfolio_id = pss.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON mci.CUSTOMER_ID = eted.main_consignee AND mci.IS_SALER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eted.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci ON sci.ACCT_NO = ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge ee ON ete.entrust_id = ee.entrust_id /** 委托指令回购质押品 **/ LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST oete ON oete.entrust_id = eted.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge oee ON oete.entrust_id = oee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON oete.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON ete.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID WHERE ete.entrust_id = #{entrustId} AND ( fscr.VDATE = ( select max(VDATE) from FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr1 where fscr1.FINPROD_ID= fscr.FINPROD_ID and fscr1.BRANCH = fscr.BRANCH and fscr1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd')) OR fscr.VDATE IS NULL ) union all
SELECT #{busiTypePosition} busiTypePosition, to_char(ete.entrust_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') entrustDate, ete.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, ete.inv_aim busiModel, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, nvl(fp.finprod_abbr,ete.finprod_id) finprodAbbr, ete.trade_market tradeMarket, ete.ps ps, DECODE(eted.SETTLE_SPREED,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed, ete.price_model priceModel, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, ete.ccy ccy, ete.entrust_num/100 shareNum, eted.our_ent_num/100 entrustOwnNum, eted.lendin_ent_num integrateSecAmount, ete.price unitPrice, eted.full_price allPrice, eted.mature_yield*100 matureYield, eted.exer_yield*100 exerYield, eted.full_price*ete.entrust_num fpriceAmt, ete.remark remark, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME mainConsignee, to_char(eted.payment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') paymentDate, to_char(eted.listing_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') listingDate, ete.entrust_num entrustNum,
decode( eted.ASSET_TYPE, 'F01', NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 ), 'F10', NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 ), NVL( ete.ENTRUST_AMT, ete.ENTRUST_NUM ) ) entrustAmt, eted.deal_mode dealMode, eted.term_type termType, to_char(eted.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || ' - ' || to_char(eted.MDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dueDate, eted.TERM_DAYS repoTerm, eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE || ' - ' || eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE2 firstprice, pss.pledge_stock_name pledgeStockName, eted.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ete.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, eted.TARGET_TYPE targetType, ete.COUNTER_ID counterId, eted.COUNTER_SEAT counterSeat, eted.COUNTER_CON_NO counterConNo, eted.TRADER trader, ete.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, FPC.CON_SHARE_ID conId, T5.FINPROD_NAME conName, eted.EXP_CON_VALUE expConValue, eted.EXP_CON_NUM expConNum, eted.PREB preb, eted.PREC prec, fpt.TYPE_11 secType, eted.DEAL_CUR_ACCT dealCurAcct, eted.REQUEST_ID requestId, eted.CAP_DAYS capDays, to_char(eted.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vpayDate, to_char(eted.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate, eted.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, eted.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt, nvl(ee.Pledge_Ratio * 100,fscr.SCALE) pledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.Pledge_Face_Value pledStrdPrinAmt, eted.TRADE_ID tradeId, oee.Pledge_Ratio * 100 oldPledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER oldPledgeNumber, oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * oee.Pledge_Face_Value oldPledStrdPrinAmt, T6.finprod_market_id oldFinprodMarketId, eted.DEAL_MODE dealMode, /** 申报类型 **/ nvl(ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.PLEDGE_RATIO , ete.ENTRUST_NUM) pledgeStandardNumber, /** 标准券额度 **/ fp.Is_Right isRight,sci.ACCT_NAME trdAcctId FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST ete INNER JOIN WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eted ON ete.entrust_id = eted.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE FPC ON ete.FINPROD_ID = FPC.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON FPC.CON_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ete.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ete.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ete.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_STOCK pss ON pss.pledge_stock_id = eted.pledge_stock_id AND ete.portfolio_id = pss.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON mci.CUSTOMER_ID = eted.main_consignee AND mci.IS_SALER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eted.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci ON sci.ACCT_NO = ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN wfl_etr_pledge ee ON ete.entrust_id = ee.entrust_id /** 委托指令回购质押品 **/ LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST oete ON oete.entrust_id = eted.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge oee ON oete.entrust_id = oee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON oete.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON ete.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID WHERE ete.entrust_id = #{entrustId} AND (fscr.VDATE = ( select max(VDATE) from FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr1 where fscr1.FINPROD_ID= fscr.FINPROD_ID and fscr1.BRANCH = fscr.BRANCH and fscr1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd')) OR fscr.VDATE IS NULL )
